text: The NFRDIP aims to integrate multiple data streams into a single, interoperable platform for real-time use, enhancing flood forecasting and early warning systems. It emphasizes leveraging existing tools like Project NOAH and GeoRiskPH, and aligns with ongoing flood risk management planning supported by the Asian Development Bank. The platform is designed to transition from reactive to preventive risk management, with phased development starting in high-risk areas.

metadata.solution_name: National Flood Risk Data Integration Platform (NFRDIP)
